meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (1MA1/2F, Monday 3 June 2024, P76924A), downloaded from qualifications.pearson.com. Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks, mark-scheme codes and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: All 28 (Total for Question) lines recovered and summing to the printed 80. Coded WITH mark_split.

coding_notes: q15 (simple interest over six years) tagged percentage_change, NOT growth_and_decay — the documented ruling, since simple interest demonstrates nothing about a repeated multiplier. The mark scheme confirms it by also accepting 0.025 × 6 as a single step.

q16a and q16b (ounces and grams off a conversion graph) tagged converting_measurements, the handling established on EDEXCEL-NOV24-F-P3 q11 — the graph is the conversion factor and the question is a unit conversion.
q22 tagged substitution alone. The formula H = 72/n is an inverse proportion, but nothing in the item tests that relationship — both marks are for substituting two values and subtracting.
q17 tagged loci then constructions: two of the three communication marks are the arc and the perpendicular bisector, and the third is the region they bound.

q26 ('show ABCD is a trapezium' from four algebraic angles) tagged angles_in_polygons then solving_linear_equations, with alternate_and_corresponding_angles third — the conclusion the final mark wants is a co-interior/allied angle statement about parallel sides.
